_readme: TMP_009 iteration 3 spike — Phase A of the multi-model pipeline pivot (PO direction 2026-05-23 after Flux quality+cost rejected). Swaps Flux dev Q8 → terrain-illustrious-xl-v1 (SDXL family) for Stage 1 content generation. Same §12 fixture (1 entry × 3 biomes × 3 seeds = 9 imgs). Key architectural differences vs the Flux baseline: (a) CFG=5.5 native — negative prompt bites without NAG ceremony, (b) SDXL ~5-10× faster than Flux Q8 GGUF expected, (c) `dark_fantasy_digital_v11` LoRA does NOT apply (Flux-specific) — replaced with the SDXL-compat LoRA stack below. Compares against the baseline NAG entry in experiments/tmp_009/REVIEW.md (cold-start tally 0/3/6, 57 s/img, n=9).
